items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Where was Joe Marcelo working then in New York? Did he ever work?

ctx.x: Yeah, Doc Randall lived with Sharpie too when he was up there. He was living with a suit. He wasn't working with Sharpie, but he was up there. Who was he working with? I don't know what he was doing. He was up in New York.
Clayton Thor, okay. I was gonna ask you some more deals I had written down here about Wingy's band. Where was Joe Marcelo working then in New York? Did he ever work?
